audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the already-audited mirror (kennen__ksante) and the packet chart: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 sat at Skill while whys[3] and whys[4] both describe Kennen controlling them, and 2+ items sat at Kennen while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say that is K'Sante's one reclaim window.
audit.why: 47.99% over 323 games; the mirror already set rows 3 and 4 to Kennen and row 6 to K'Sante.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side + win[3] -> Kennen, phases[4].side + win[4] -> Kennen, phases[6].side + win[6] -> K'Sante, as matched pairs with inverted ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slicing Maelstrom and Lightning Rush were both described without a number, so 'commit when his ult is spent' had no duration attached to it.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s and Lightning Rush 10/9/8/7/6s — a 120s window is the entire reason the level-6 stage is survivable at all.
audit.corrected: 120s written into whys[5] and wants.you[2], 10/9/8/7/6s into the interactions row and dosFull[0].d.
sources: kit: Kennen R 120, E 10/9/8/7/6, Q 950 range

audit.whatIsWrong: Four errors. (1) 'W's unstoppable charge' in four paths — Riot's Path Maker text says reduced damage taken while charging, never unstoppable. (2) 'Q3 knock-up' — Ntofo Strikes has no knockup; at 2 stacks it fires a shockwave that pulls. (3) 'his move-speed passive' in four paths — Kennen's passive is Mark of the Storm, a 3-stack stun; the move speed is Lightning Rush (E). (4) 'energy-free Q/W' — Thundering Shuriken costs 60/55/50/45/40 energy and Electrical Surge 40, and his early energy pool is a real constraint.
audit.why: Kit text is the authority. Telling a reader Kennen's poke is free and his passive gives move speed makes them play the energy-drained windows completely wrong.
audit.corrected: Move speed reattributed to Lightning Rush, 'energy-free' replaced with the 950-range shuriken, the pull corrected, and W described as charge-up damage reduction. Electrical Surge's on-hit application written into the itemization row so armour is not read as the answer.
sources: kit: Kennen P/Q/W/E text and costs

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are his to control. His move-speed passive and energy-free Q/W mean he kites my short Q-W range all day and chips me down while I have no way to close without burning W. At 6 his Slicing Maelstrom plus a three-mark stun is the scary window — if I W-charge in carelessly his R stun-lock chains right through my CC immunity the instant the charge ends, and he kites my All Out duel for free. So I don't dive a healthy Kennen with R up: I bait his Q poke and his ult, soak it on my bulk, and only commit W when his Maelstrom is spent.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are his to control. At 6 Slicing Maelstrom plus a three-mark Mark of the Storm stun is the scary window — his R runs a flat 120s but stun-locks me the moment my charge ends, and he kites the All Out duel for free. So I don't dive a healthy Kennen with R up: I bait his Q, soak the ult on my bulk, and commit W only once Maelstrom is spent.

edits.before: Kennen has no engage threat at level 1 and neither do I with only Q, so the first level is a farm standoff — I tank a little Thundering Shuriken poke and last-hit with the tip of Ntofo Strikes. The problem starts at 2-3 once his Mark of the Storm chain is online: he Q-pokes me, weaves an Electrical Surge auto, and the third stack stuns me before I can ever reach him. My only real answer is level 3 — if he steps into Q range to CS or poke, I Path Maker charge into him and Q3 to knock him up and pull him in, the one trade I actually win. Otherwise I eat poke and stay healthy.

edits.before: This is the only stretch that swings to me, and it's why the lane stays tricky rather than lost. Kennen is a squishy AP carry with no percent-HP or true damage, so my armor and HP actually matter against him — once I have a tank item or two, his Q/W poke stops zoning me and I walk through it. With first item I force the side-lane all-in his energy poke can't dodge forever, and from 2+ items my R All Out flips into a duelist profile that runs his fragile body down after I survive his combo with W's unstoppable charge. In teamfights my R peels him off my carries before his AoE Maelstrom lands. I have to reach this window even on his terms — close on my tank spike, don't bet on out-poking him.

notes: The mirror flagged three sub-25-character strings it could not touch; on this side the equivalents are dosFull[2].t 'W-tank his combo' (16 chars) and dontsFull[1].t 'Get triple-stunned' (18 chars) — both under the applier's skip threshold, both fine as written, no action needed. Lightning Rush is a form-change with move speed and unit-passthrough, not a dash; nothing here calls it one. Whether Mark of the Storm's stun is affected by tenacity is not in the kit data and was not asserted.
